newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Governor says Rwanda refugees kill Zaireans.
newsitem.headline: Governor says Rwanda refugees kill Zaireans.

text.p: Rwandan refugees attacked a Zairean village near their camp south of Kisangani on Monday, killing up to eight residents, the region's governor said.

"There is tension across the (Zaire) river and this morning we heard the population is angry because the refugees killed six or eight Zairean people," Eastern Province Governor Yagi Sitolo told reporters.

"That is why we sent a group to see what has happened there," he said. In Geneva, U.N. refugee agency chief Sadako Ogata said a rebel military operation near Kasese camp south of Kisangani raised the prospect of a new Rwandan refugee exodus.

Rwandan refugees attacked a village 25 km (15 miles) south of Kisangani and killed six villagers early on Monday, according to Zairean residents of Lula, a village seven km (four miles) south of the city.
Some of the angry residents armed with knives and pangas told Reuters they spent the morning and part of the night looting vehicles at the urging of rebels who seized Kisangani on March 15.
